guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice_diskio jumped from 0 to ~4023 (by far the largest anomaly), and its latency-50 rose +859% while its CPU (+47%) and socket count (+49%) rose only moderately, with memory nearly flat (+9%). Frontend and checkoutservice latency rises are downstream effects, since both call currencyservice and the worst traces all pass through it, while productcatalogservice and other services stay near baseline.

proposed_fix.description: Find and throttle the process generating heavy disk I/O on the currencyservice pod (for example, a runaway disk writer), then restart or reschedule the pod onto a healthy node and check its volume and disk health. Non-destructive: no data is deleted.
